title: Capture Grok Bot fixtures
description:
Capture fixture data from a real Grok Bot installation on a Mac, locally: session transcripts with human messages, injected content classes, duplicates/forks if any. Encode findings into synthetic fixtures under tests/fixtures/sentiment/grok-bot/; never commit real transcripts.

Done when: synthetic fixtures encode the observed format; findings record the evidence.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: BLOCKED on KDATAP-f66d10: fixture capture requires a real Grok Bot installation on Ryan's Mac — this VM has no macOS and no Grok Bot app. Plan once research lands: copy (locally only) sample conversations covering plain human messages, injected content classes, and any duplicates/forks; hand-author synthetic fixtures under tests/fixtures/sentiment/grok-bot/ encoding the observed format (never commit real transcripts — the fixture guard enforces size/binary limits); then f37d2e implements the adapter against them.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Done (commit 2473f3b). Synthetic fixtures at tests/fixtures/sentiment/grok-bot/sand-client-persistence/ mirroring the real app layout per the f66d10 research:
- Two conversation blobs (solo + crew shapes) with base32-of-storage-key filenames; contents cover: persona send-message text/widget/cursor-agent sends, no-author greeting/reply sends, crew-authored sends (Charlie Munger, Scanner, Project Manager), plain role=user messages (thanks + f-bomb), role=user fromAgent crew posts, role=assistant toAgent relay, role=user fromUser remote-channel message, voice-call and event entries, an empty-content malformed entry, and a widgetSkipped send.
- One unparseable blob (per-file failure guard) and one non-transcript blob (sand.client.slice.ui-layout) that discovery must skip.
- tests/fixtures/sentiment/README.md documents the grok-bot subtree.
All text is hand-authored synthetic; no real session content. Fixture-guard test passes.
